init_hook: docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Docker daemon is not running'; exit 1; }
trap 'echo "Stopping docker containers..."; docker compose down' EXIT

scripts.users: cd users && pnpm exec nest start --watch && echo 'Welcome to users project!' > /dev/null
scripts.projects: cd projects && pnpm exec nest start --watch && echo 'Welcome to projects project !' > /dev/null
